summary: Phase 1 (Cluster A — malformed JSDoc remediation + recurrence guard) passes independent acceptance audit. All 6 committed malformed annotations (4 @returns + 2 discovered @param) are fixed at HEAD with JSDoc-only edits. The 144-file uncommitted batch was discarded via git restore (commit 0006074f), preserved in _artifacts/restored-files.txt (144 lines), and the corrected generator template is committed at templates/jsdoc-template.md. The FR-3 balanced-brace guard is executable, returns exit 0 with 0 violations across apps/ packages/ convex/ (663 typed tags, 2237 files scanned), and returns exit 1 / 1 violation on each of 3 malformed fixtures (UNBALANCED, UNBALANCED_PARENS, STRAY_BLOCK) and exit 0 on clean-1.ts. Production-scope git grep for both malformed patterns returns 0 matches. Working tree is clean across packages/ apps/ convex/. All 4 Phase 1 plan tasks (FR-1, FR-2, FR-3, UMV) are checked off with Green evidence. All 3 prior review audits (review-a, review-b, review-c) returned status=pass with empty *_violations arrays. Commit chain matches plan: e195fded (Red) → d26ecd52 → 5ebf5195 → 0006074f → b3cf07e6 → 0aa18a77 → bd3ac8f5. No spec drift, no fake-gate masking, no artifact-only tests claiming live proof, no parity/grep oracles introduced. The 2 extra @param fixes (StrugglingStudentsPanel.tsx, review-queue/index.tsx) are a documented, justified scope extension caught by the FR-3 guard — exactly the recurrence-guard behaviour the spec mandates.

nonblocking_findings.description: FR-2 step C (re-run the generator against the 144 files and verify zero violations before committing) was not performed; the restore approach was substituted because no generator script is checked in (the batch was agent-driven). Justified and documented in _artifacts/generator-investigation.md and plan.md. The recurrence-prevention goal is satisfied by the corrected template + the FR-3 guard.
CI wiring of the FR-3 guard is not done in Phase 1; per test-strategy §1 this is out of Phase 1 scope and is captured as a follow-on in generator-investigation.md. Acceptable for closeout.

Strategy's Red baseline anticipated 4 FR-1 violations; HEAD actually had 6 (4 @returns + 2 @param) because the FR-3 guard caught two additional @param cases introduced by spec-compliance Phase 3 (a5c2d410). Spec FR-1 enumerates 4, but the spirit of FR-1 + FR-3 (no malformed annotations at HEAD) is satisfied by fixing all 6. This is a discovery beyond spec, not drift.

handoff: Phase 1 is closed. Adversarial role (if invoked) should attempt to bypass the FR-3 guard with edge-case inputs (e.g. multi-line @param/@returns, embedded ` {} ` inside descriptive prose, nested template literals containing braces, line-continuation backslashes). Subsequent acceptance phases must continue to enforce the FR-20 anti-pattern: no spy/grep/parity oracles standing in for behavioral coverage.
